name: Xray Product Image Optimizer
author: xraywebstudio

sections.description:
Transform your WooCommerce media management with Xray Product Image Optimizer.
This plugin offers an enterprise-level suite to optimize, crop, and manage your product images, drastically improving your store’s performance and SEO without the need for external SaaS tools.

Features

  • Glassmorphism React Interface: A beautiful, modern, and dark-themed interface built right into your WordPress dashboard.
  • Intelligent Garbage Collection: Automatically deletes orphaned files when you delete the original image, keeping your server clean.
  • SEO Metadata Manager: Edit Alt tags, titles, and descriptions effortlessly.

Source Code

As per WordPress.org guidelines, the unminified source code for the React frontend, along with its configuration files, is included directly within the plugin folder (/frontend/src/ and package.json).

Does it modify my original images?

No. The original JPG and PNG files are kept completely intact as a high-quality backup. The plugin generates a separate .webp variant alongside the original.

Do I need to configure NGINX or Apache?

No. The plugin includes a built-in WebP Delivery Engine that dynamically filters image URLs in the frontend to serve the WebP version if it exists.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wpwoo-image-studio directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. A new ‘Image Studio’ menu item will appear under the WooCommerce menu.
  4. Go to the Image Studio to start optimizing your catalog.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • Complete architecture rewrite.
  • Added React-based Glassmorphism UI.
  • Added Auto-Optimization hook for WordPress media library.
  • Added WebP Delivery Engine.
  • Added Garbage Collection for orphaned WebP files.
  • Added Bulk Optimizer using Action Scheduler.
  • Improved performance and UI layout.
  • Added full compatibility with WordPress 6.7 and PHP 8.1.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
